game.desc: Dark Souls II: Scholar of the First Sin on 360 is a compilation that includes Dark Souls II, the original title, and its three DLCs, Crown of the Sunken King, Crown of the Old Iron King and Crown of the Ivory King, as well as additional story content, NPCs, enemies and gameplay improvements.
